# Issue #112: last page is followed by a phantom empty page

With 9 items and `per_page=3`, `paginate(items, 3, 3)` says `has_next` is true and
`total_pages` is 4. Page 4 then comes back as an empty list instead of an error.
This only happens when the item count is an exact multiple of `per_page`; 10 items
at 3 per page is fine. Fix `pager/paginate.py`.

pager/paginate.py
tests/test_paginate.py

  36|         "items": list(items[start:start + per_page]),

The bug is in `page_count`: `total_items // per_page + 1` always adds an extra page, so when the count is an exact multiple of `per_page`, a phantom empty page gets created. The correct formula is ceiling division, with a minimum of 1 page for an empty collection.

Tests pass. Let me quickly verify the exact scenario from the issue:

arguments.command:
python -c "
from pager.paginate import paginate
items = list(range(9))
p3 = paginate(items, 3, 3)
print('page3:', p3['total_pages'], p3['has_next'])
try:
    paginate(items, 4, 3)
    print('ERROR: page 4 did not raise')
except ValueError as e:
    print('page4 raises:', e)
print('10 items:', paginate(list(range(10)), 4, 3)['total_pages'], paginate(list(range(10)), 4, 3)['has_next'])
print('empty:', paginate([], 1, 3)['total_pages'])
"

content:
exit=0
page3: 3 False
page4 raises: page 4 out of range 1..3
10 items: 4 False
empty: 1

All scenarios from the issue are fixed:
- 9 items at 3/page: `total_pages=3`, `has_next=False` on page 3, and page 4 now raises `ValueError` instead of returning an empty list
- 10 items at 3/page: still 4 pages, unchanged
- Empty collection: still reports 1 page

The root cause was `total_items // per_page + 1`, which always over-counts by one page when the item count is an exact multiple of `per_page`. I replaced it with ceiling division `(total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page`, with a special case returning 1 page for an empty collection.

arguments.summary: Fixed the phantom empty page bug in pager/paginate.py: page_count used `total_items // per_page + 1`, which over-counts by one page when the item count is an exact multiple of per_page. Replaced it with ceiling division `(total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page` (returning 1 for an empty collection), so 9 items at 3/page now reports 3 pages, has_next is False on the last page, and requesting page 4 raises ValueError as expected.
